about.paragraph2: I enjoy combining visual craftsmanship with technical problem-solving to create work that is not only beautiful but genuinely useful.

about.headline: a one-person studio for pictures that have to move.
about.intro: Zubair makes 3D and motion for product brands, apps, and small studios. The work on this site is dummy layout content so the design can be reviewed before real projects go in.
about.startBody: A short brief, two references, and the place the file will live. That is enough to price a first round.
about.finishBody: Preview stills, one revision pass on the approved frames, then final exports for web and a master file.
about.hireBody: Upwork is the front door. Start a conversation with a clear brief and references.

services.headline: what you can hire.
services.intro: Written the way an Upwork client scans a profile: outcome first, then the files they receive.

offers.title: Product stills and turntables
offers.detail: One hero angle, three supporting angles, and a 4–6 second loop. Useful for Shopify, Amazon, and pitch decks.

offers.title: Character and mascot
offers.detail: A model, a simple rig, and three poses or a short loop. Built so later shots stay on-model.

offers.title: Spaces
offers.detail: Interior or exterior stills with lighting that matches the brand, not a default studio HDRI.

offers.title: Explainers and app motion
offers.detail: A short film or UI animation with a storyboard first, so the edit does not wander.
